name: mcp-drift-guard
description: A lockfile for the tools your MCP servers declare. Fails CI when a server's tool names, descriptions or schemas change. Cross-checks the signed MCP Drift Observatory feed over RSS-A.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && esbuild src/action.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/action.js && cp dist/cli.js plugin/dist/cli.js
